post_text: Feed post Adewale Adeniyi • 1st Tech Apostle | Founder At SentryAfrica | PMP | Career Education | Data Science | ML | Deep Learning | Generative AI | Transformational Leadership | Web Development. 1mo I can't believe SIS 8 holds next week. My Lagos people are on fire already! 🔥 From August 27th to 29th, changemakers from all over the continent are coming together for the 8th edition of the Sustaining Impact Summit. The momentum is absolutely incredible, and you do not want to be left out of this conversation. We have made it easier than ever to plug in, no matter where you are: 💻 Going Virtual? Secure your digital pass and join from anywhere at https://lnkd.in/ezekyHa9 🌍 Craving In-Person Connection? We have 17+ physical locations hosting across Africa! Head to https://lnkd.in/e4D-hrqr , select the "In-Person" path, and choose the hub closest to your city. 🇳🇬 For my Nigerian network: Watch the video below for the exact details on how to join the massive energy at our Lagos location! The countdown is officially on. Are you logging in virtually or walking into a physical hub next week? Let me know in the comments and grab your spot today! 👇 #SIS8 #SustainingImpact #SocialImpact #AfricaInnovates #TechForGood #Lagos … more 9 ​ ​ ​
post_summary: Adewale Adeniyi is promoting the Sustaining Impact Summit (SIS8), an Africa-wide hybrid conference (Aug 27–29) with virtual passes and 17+ in-person hubs, highlighting Lagos activity and inviting participants to join. The post links to registration and encourages engagement about attending virtually or in person.
